description: Japan Meteorological Agency past weather data download is a data repository run by Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA). The service lets users select stations and elements and download observed temperature, precipitation, wind, snow and sunshine series at hourly, daily and monthly resolution for the JMA station network. Coverage: Japan (JMA stations, some records from the 19th century). It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("気象庁|過去の気象データ・ダウンロード") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support weather drivers for demand, outage and flood studies of Japanese infrastructure. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
